shortDescription: A whale opened a 10x long position on 403.44 BTC and a 12x long position on 4,781 ETH on Hyperliquid at around 3 a.m. today, with the trades currently showing an unrealized loss of $362,000. According to Odaily, this was the whale's first derivatives trade on Hyperliquid.

title: Whale Opens First Hyperliquid Futures Trades With Leveraged BTC and ETH Longs
